title: Hybrid join is used as the device control instead of compliance

report.title: {Items.Count} {Plural(Items.Count, 'policy relies', 'policies rely')} on hybrid join rather than compliance

messages.businessImpact: Hybrid join proves a device is domain joined, not that it is encrypted, patched or protected. It is a statement about membership rather than health.
remediation: Add require device to be marked as compliant, keeping hybrid join if the estate still needs it.
